description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeEvaluationAPI class within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It handles API endpoints related to employee performance reviews and evaluations, including retrieving evaluation data, updating review ratings and comments, and managing workflow states. The class extends SupervisorEvaluationAPI and implements methods for handling performance review data, permissions, and validation rules.

classes.name: EmployeeEvaluationAPI
classes.description: A PHP API class handling employee performance review evaluations within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It provides endpoints for retrieving evaluation data, updating ratings and comments, and managing workflow states related to employee performance reviews.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves the employee's evaluation data for a specific review, including ratings, comments, reviewer info, and permitted actions.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating the employee evaluation, including additional validation for the 'complete' boolean parameter.
